scenes.title: V2 town: the walk to curry

beats.text: AKIBA · 2:45 PM. Big signs. Big screens. She holds your hand.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: We are going out for curry. Just you and me.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: So many people. I will hold your arm. Tight.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Wow! A giant oshi board. Oshi means "my favorite."

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: But not one of them is as cute as me. Right?
